title: DOJ deems EEOC’s disparate impact discrimination guidelines unconstitutional
summary: The push against disparate impact liability has been a focus of the Trump administration.

title: Firefighter’s Title VII claims survive preclusion even if the rest of his claims don’t, 7th Circuit says
summary: The U.S. Supreme Court has said that federal job discrimination claims are not barred by certain state agencies’ administrative decisions, per the ruling.

title: Americans mostly blame insurers for rising healthcare costs, survey finds
summary: Insurer groups said the survey was skewed against their industry and that hospitals are largely at fault for spiking costs.

title: Recruiters have doubled their call time in the past 2 years
summary: As artificial intelligence tools have streamlined certain tasks, HR professionals have used the time saved to make more human connections with applicants and clients, per a new report.

title: Copy-and-paste AI work can hurt workers’ feelings of ownership, researchers say
summary: Passive use of artificial intelligence to complete certain tasks may erode workers’ confidence in the long-term, according to a recent study, even if it boosts productivity.

title: How flexible work will help working dads, too
summary: Remote work has often been championed for its benefit for working moms, but new insights remind employers how it can help working dads as well.

title: NAACP accuses EEOC of stalling on its records request
summary: According to the civil rights organization, the agency used a fee waiver denial to “delay and obstruct” its access to records that are in the public interest.

title: Employers don’t have to build the AI algorithm to own the liability
summary: Some companies and HR leaders assume legal risk lies with the software vendor that created or licensed artificial intelligence tools, but this is often not the case.

title: Coalition requests judge halt Trump’s anti-DEI contractor order
summary: The group, led by the National Association of Diversity Officers in Higher Education, filed a lawsuit over the executive order in April.

title: Trump’s $100K fee for H-1B visas struck down
summary: A federal judge ruled that the fee amounted to an unlawful tax on the visa program for highly skilled workers.
